faq.title: 常见问题
faq.copy: 按主题整理「现象 → 原因 → 怎么办」，每一条都给你能直接照做的下一步。
faq.note: 还有别的问题？到「参考文档」里按主题查

items.a: 在登录页点「忘记密码？」，填写账号绑定的邮箱后点「发送」；平台会把重置密码链接发到邮箱，从邮件里点链接即可设置新密码。

items.q: 登录后被要求选租户，租户列表却是空的？
items.a: 说明你还没加入任何租户。可以在租户选择页注册新租户，或请管理员把你加进某个租户。

items.q: 创建推理服务时，「规格」卡片没有可选项？
items.a: 当前工作空间的配额不足，或没有可用算力。联系租户管理员调整配额，或先停掉其他不用的实例。

items.q: 实例状态一直是「已安装」？
items.a: 正在拉取镜像或加载模型。进入实例详情的「事件」页，确认镜像拉取是否成功。
401 是密钥错误或过期：检查请求头是否为 Bearer 你的密钥，必要时重新创建；429 是触发限速：在「API 密钥」里调大 RPM / TPM，或降低调用频率。
当前角色确实没有该操作权限。对照权限说明找出需要的角色，联系租户管理员调整后重试。

faq.title: Frequently asked
faq.copy: Organized as symptom, cause and fix — every answer ends with a next step you can actually take.
faq.note: Still stuck? Browse the reference docs by topic.

items.q: I forgot my password — what now?
items.a: On the sign-in page choose “Forgot password?”, enter the email bound to your account and submit. We send a reset link to that address; open it to set a new password.

items.q: I signed in but the tenant list is empty.
items.a: That means you have not joined any tenant yet. Register a new tenant on the selection page, or ask an administrator to add you to one.

items.q: The spec cards are empty when I create an inference service.
items.a: The current workspace is out of quota, or no compute is available. Ask your tenant administrator to raise the quota, or stop instances you are not using.
It is still pulling the image or loading the model. Open the instance's Events tab and confirm the image pull succeeded.
401 means a wrong or expired key: check that the header is Bearer <your key>, and recreate the key if needed. 429 means rate limiting: raise RPM / TPM on the API keys page, or slow down.
Your current role genuinely lacks that permission. Find the required role in the permission reference and ask your tenant administrator to grant it.
